anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottlenecks.
AI system has not generated any opportunities or made adjustments, which could indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading system shows zero profit/loss and win rate, which might suggest inactivity or issues with trade execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review and potentially update AI models or configurations to ensure they are functioning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are aligned with market conditions and capable of executing trades effectively.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough analysis of the CPU usage to identify and resolve any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns or crashes, impacting the platform's reliability and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform diagnostics on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating trading opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: The AI's inactivity could mean missed trading opportunities and reduced platform performance.

recommendations.action: Review the trading system's configuration and strategy effectiveness to ensure they are properly executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: Zero profit/loss and win rate suggest potential issues with trade execution or strategy performance.
